title: Sweet & Sour Sauce – Quick Takeout Style
description: Fast, tangy, sweet, and irresistibly familiar — your shortcut to classic Chinese takeout flavour at home.

method.instruction: Combine sugar, vinegar, tomato sauce, soy sauce, and pineapple juice in a small saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
In a small bowl, mix cornflour with water to form a smooth slurry. Stir into the saucepan.
Continue stirring until the sauce thickens, about 1–2 minutes. Remove from heat and cool slightly before serving.

notes.title: Serving Tip
notes.content: Perfect with fried chicken, pork, or prawns. Also great as a dipping sauce for spring rolls or drizzled over stir-fried vegetables.
